root_cause: Connections are autocommit (isolation_level=None). Legality checks ran in Python on a separately-read row (SELECT then check), the UPDATEs carried no predicates (WHERE id=? only), and the audit log() was a separate statement. Under concurrency: fail() could fail a job whose lease was reclaimed mid-call (no AND lease_owner=?); release() could release a renewed lease; transition() could apply a move the job had already left; fail_drive() could steal the lease holder's failure path; and a crash between UPDATE and log() lost the audit entry.
